name: Runebound Battle Axe
description: Double-bitted axe etched with glowing runes of power. Perfectly balanced for the discerning warrior.

name: Mountain King Shield
description: Heavy iron shield reinforced with adamantite. Bears the crest of the High King.

name: Thane's Crown
description: A ceremonial circlet forged from deep-mountain gold, set with unpolished rubies.

name: Forgemaster's Hammer
description: A blackened steel crafting hammer. It has shaped a thousand blades and will shape a thousand more.

name: Ironclad Bracers
description: Thick leather bracers plated with interlocking iron scales. Flexible yet impenetrable.

name: Ancestor's Amulet
description: A heavy stone pendant carved with the visage of a clan ancestor. Radiates a faint warmth.
